descr: se sentó una señora con su hijo al frente mío en el bus y al ver que llevaba las gafas lo miro bastante y se empezó a arreglar un montón, no me dijo nada pero parecía que se estaba arreglando como si la estuvieran grabando jajajaaj, yo iba con audífonos y vi que le apunto a su hijo un poco las gafas, pero me dio vergüenza y no dije nada😅
future_use: me dio más vergüenza usarlas, son bastante incómodas en espacios públicos
descr_english: A woman sat opposite me on the bus with her son and, when she saw I was wearing the glasses, she kept looking at them and started fixing herself up a lot. She did not say anything to me, but it seemed as though she was preparing for a recording or something. I could see her pointing out my glasses to her son, but I felt too embarrassed to say anything. 😅
future_use_english: It made me more embarrassed to use them; they are quite uncomfortable in public spaces.

descr: persona me pregunto que eran las gafas y si estaba grabando
descr_english: Someone asked me what the glasses were and whether I was recording.
